fields.Name: T166 - Test Runs Status Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke chip-based client-side status filter (filterByStatus over TestRunWithFeedbackSummary from the instrumentation service), not the generic entity-grid column filter.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing", then click the "Runs" tab. The Runs view shows a filter bar with status chips: All, Running, Passed, Failed, Error. Click the "Passed" chip, then the "Failed" chip, observing that the chip becomes highlighted/active and the runs table plus the result count respond each time — narrowing to matching runs, or showing a clear "No test runs found" empty state when nothing matches. Then click "All" to restore. Success is that the status chips visibly drive the table contents. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Runs view shows status filter chips (All, Running, Passed, Failed, Error)
Clicking a status chip marks it active and updates the runs table and/or the results count
When a filter yields nothing, a clear 'No test runs found' empty state appears instead of a broken table
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
